model_sql.member_first_orders: SELECT member_id, first_ordered_at, first_net_cents FROM (SELECT member_id, ordered_at AS first_ordered_at, paid_cents - refund_cents AS first_net_cents, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS rn FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) t WHERE rn = 1
model_sql.member_followup_orders: SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at FROM (SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS rn FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) t WHERE rn >= 2
model_sql.member_month_agg: SELECT member_id || '-' || strftime(stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS member_month, member_id, stat_month, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_cnt, SUM(paid_cents - refund_cents) AS net_sales_cents FROM (SELECT member_id, date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS stat_month, paid_cents, refund_cents FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) v GROUP BY member_id, stat_month
model_sql.member_month_paid: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT member_id, date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS stat_month, paid_cents, refund_cents FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0), agg AS (SELECT member_id, stat_month, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_cnt, SUM(paid_cents - refund_cents) AS net_sales_cents FROM valid_orders GROUP BY member_id, stat_month), eligible AS (SELECT a.member_id, a.stat_month FROM agg a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('cards') }} c WHERE c.member_id = a.member_id AND c.card_type IN ('悦享年卡','家庭季卡') AND c.valid_from <= last_day(a.stat_month) AND c.valid_until > last_day(a.stat_month) AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR c.ended_at > last_day(a.stat_month)))) SELECT a.member_id || '-' || strftime(a.stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS member_month, a.member_id, a.stat_month, CASE WHEN e.member_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS eligible, a.valid_order_cnt, a.net_sales_cents FROM agg a LEFT JOIN eligible e ON a.member_id = e.member_id AND a.stat_month = e.stat_month

business_model_usage.quote: 付费会员只算悦享年卡和家庭季卡的持有人；异业联名卡虽收费但由合作方经营、不进自营会员范围，体验卡不算
门店判断资格按账户看、不按卡张数；账户可无卡或持多张卡，只要有一张卡在判定日有效且属本次业务范围，该账户即有资格，多张有效卡不重复算人
卡从生效日期当天起有效，到有效期结束日期当天已无效（不含结束日），有提前终止日期的从提前终止当天起无效；须对判定日核对
先选月末有资格的账户，再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单，不要求每笔订单发生当天已具备资格
